Maria F.: Heads up — running the monthly GPU recon and found ~$12,400 in GPU credits charged to project 'shared-research-2025' with no team label. Looks like orphan spend, CSV export attached.
CostBot: Invoice 2025-03-GPU-789 uploaded to #finance (s3://billing/2025/03/2025-03-GPU-789.csv)
Alex B.: Can you paste the GCP project id and billing account? I can run a quick label scan.
Maria F.: proj: shared-research-2025, billingAccount: BA-9987. Labels missing: `team:` absent, `owner:` absent. Suspect some ad-hoc infra job spun up VMs without tags.
Lee C.: That project was used for the internal LLM benchmark last month. I thought we added `team=ml-platform` but maybe terraform drifted. I'll check the infra changes.
Priya S.: For the finance side, we can retroactively attribute costs but need an owner confirmation and sign-off. Maria, can you confirm exact dollar amounts by day so we can propose a reallocation?
Maria F.: Attached the daily spend snippet — Mar 10-14 is the bulk. I'll drop the CSV to the thread.
Sam G.: I pre-approve reallocations up to $15k to internal teams if infra confirms ownership. Proceed and document in ledger.
Alex B.: Quick check I ran: `gcloud compute instances list --project=shared-research-2025 --filter="labels.team:*"` returned zero. There's definitely a tagging gap. Opening PR to add enforcement and a policy in org policy.
Priya S.: Also setting a near-term budget alert: creating an alert to fire if any project has untagged GPU spend > $2k/day. Will link to ops ticket.
CostBot: Alert created: "untagged-gpu-spend-2000-day" and connected to INC-2332.
Maria F.: Perfect — once Lee confirms ownership I'll run the manual allocation for Mar invoice and attach the approval. Leaving this thread as the audit trail. :white_check_mark:
